






```{r}
# ---- Libraries ----
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# ---- Source the reduced closure functions ----
source(here("scripts", "reduced_ingestion_closure.R"))
```


```{r}
# ---- Traits (your example) ----
trait_list <- list(
  largePel = list(
    a_a = 80, b_R = 0.85,
    a_g = 3, hm = 1,
    f_m = 0.1, a_m = 1, b_m = 0.75,
    a_e = 200, b_e = 2/3,
    a_c = 60, b_c = 0.75, epsAssim = 0.7, alpha = 0.2,
    T_ref = 10,
    Q10_m = 2.00, Q10_a = 1.80, Q10_o = 1.50, Q10_c = 2.00
  )
)
tr <- trait_list[["largePel"]]
```


```{r}
# ---- Panel settings ----
masses   <- c(1e0, 1e4)               # columns
T_panels <- c(5, 20)                  # rows
pO2seq   <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.1)
B_seq    <- 10^seq(-2, 3, length.out = 400)

# ---- Run reduced surfaces (this is fast vs optimize()) ----
surf <- compute_state_surface_reduced(
  tr,
  masses = masses,
  Tseq   = T_panels,
  pO2seq = pO2seq,
  Bseq   = B_seq,
  D      = 3,
  u_prey = 0,
  normalize_E = FALSE,   # we'll plot raw E_net as E_avail
  progress = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
surf <- as_tibble(surf) %>%
  mutate(
    B    = B_used,
    mass = as.numeric(mass),
    T    = as.numeric(T),
    E_avail = E_net / Cmax
  )

# ---- Masks: black if pO2 < pO2_crit, gray if E_avail < 0 (but above crit) ----
surf <- surf %>%
  mutate(
    mask_black = is.finite(pO2_crit) & pO2 < pO2_crit,
    mask_gray  = !mask_black & is.finite(E_avail) & (E_avail < 0),
    E_pos      = if_else(!mask_black & !mask_gray & is.finite(E_avail), E_avail, NA_real_)
  )
```


```{r}
# ---- Plot helpers ----
base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey50", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.title = element_text(size=8),
    legend.text  = element_text(size=6, color="gray30"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey50"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)
  )

strip_y <- function(p) p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                 axis.text.y  = element_blank())
strip_x <- function(p) p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                                 axis.text.x  = element_blank())
```


```{r fig.height=4.5, fig.width=3.5, warning=FALSE}
B_limits <- range(B_seq, finite = TRUE)
B_breaks <- 10^seq(floor(log10(B_limits[1])), ceiling(log10(B_limits[2])), by = 1)

# Panel order: top row = higher T; left col = smaller mass
combos <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  T = sort(unique(surf$T), decreasing = TRUE),
  mass = sort(unique(surf$mass))
) %>% mutate(key = paste0("T=", T, " | m=", signif(mass, 3)))

plots <- vector("list", nrow(combos))
names(plots) <- combos$key

# Color scale (positive E_avail only)
Emax <- max(surf$E_pos, na.rm = TRUE)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
  T_i <- combos$T[i]
  m_i <- combos$mass[i]
  nm  <- combos$key[i]

  df_i <- surf %>% filter(T == T_i, mass == m_i)

  df_black <- df_i %>% filter(mask_black)
  df_gray  <- df_i %>% filter(mask_gray)
  df_pos   <- df_i %>% filter(is.finite(E_pos))

  p <- ggplot() +
    # positive E_avail surface
    geom_raster(data = df_pos, aes(x = B, y = pO2, fill = E_pos), interpolate = FALSE) +

    # dashed f contours
    geom_contour(
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      data = df_i %>% filter(is.finite(f), is.finite(B), is.finite(pO2)),
      aes(x = B, y = pO2, z = f),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      colour = "black", linewidth = 0.30, linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    # thick near-saturation
    geom_contour(
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      data = df_i %>% filter(is.finite(f), is.finite(B), is.finite(pO2)),
      aes(x = B, y = pO2, z = f),
      breaks = 0.99,
      colour = "black", linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    
    # black mask (pO2 < pO2_crit)
    geom_raster(data = df_black, aes(x = B, y = pO2), fill = "black", interpolate = FALSE) +
    # gray mask (E_avail < 0 above crit)
    geom_raster(data = df_gray, aes(x = B, y = pO2), fill = "gray60", interpolate = FALSE) +

    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white", high = "#67A5CA",
      limits = c(0, 1),
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = expression(E[avail])
    ) +

    labs(x = "Prey biomass B", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~"(kPa)")) +
    scale_x_log10(
      limits = B_limits,
      breaks = B_breaks,
      labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x)),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(pO2seq), max(pO2seq), by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    base_theme +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

  # Optional: add a title per panel
  # p <- p + ggtitle(paste0("T=", T_i, "°C, m=", format(m_i, scientific = TRUE), " g")) +
  #   theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8))

  plots[[nm]] <- p
}

# Arrange 2x2 with shared legend (patchwork)
# combos$key order: (T high, m small), (T high, m large), (T low, m small), (T low, m large)
p11 <- plots[[ combos$key[3] ]]
p12 <- plots[[ combos$key[4] ]]
p21 <- plots[[ combos$key[1] ]]
p22 <- plots[[ combos$key[2] ]]

# strip axes to match your Fig.3 layout
p11 <- strip_x(p11)
p12 <- strip_x(strip_y(p12))
p22 <- strip_y(p22)

grid_E_2x2 <- ((p11 | p12) / (p21 | p22)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.justification = "center")

grid_E_2x2
```
